channel.title: Okendo - Product Releases
channel.description: New features and updates to Okendo (unofficial feed).

item.title: [Loyalty] Loyalty points now account for tax on tax-inclusive orders
item.description:
Okendo Loyalty now correctly applies tax settings when calculating qualifying spend for points on orders and refunds. Merchants with tax-inclusive pricing, such as those in NZ or AU subject to GST, will see more accurate points allocations on new orders. Taxes are no longer double-counted or incorrectly omitted based on the merchant’s configured tax inclusion setting.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - July 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Set VIP program start date for loyalty VIP tiers
item.description:
Set a VIP Program Start Date in Loyalty Settings before launching a VIP program. This defines the date from which customer spend is calculated for tier eligibility, allowing you to backdate tier assignment so customers are recognized at the right tier from launch. The maximum lookback period is 36 months.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - July 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Set attributes as optional
item.description:
Set any attribute, product or profile, as optional when adding them to an attribute collection, allowing for greater customization of the review journey, reducing friction for shoppers.
(Enhancement / Reviews - July 2026)

item.title: [Quarterly Release] Q2 2026 Product Updates
item.description:
From AI-powered review replies to loyalty experiences that extend beyond your store, unlock powerful new ways to engage shoppers, reward members, and make every interaction feel effortless.
(Quarterly Release - July 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Custom tag IDs are now visible and copyable in the admin
item.description:
Merchants can now see and copy the ID for any custom tag directly from their Reviews Widget settings.
(Enhancement / Reviews - June 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Merchants can now include incentivized status when exporting
item.description:
Review exports now include incentivized status, showing whether a review was incentivized with a coupon, loyalty points or gifted.
(Enhancement / Reviews - June 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Merchants can now specify a review status when importing reviews
item.description:
Set the status of imported reviews as pending, approved, or rejected.
(Enhancement / Reviews - June 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Set redemption limits on rewards
item.description:
Merchants can now set per-member redemption limits on individual reward rules in Okendo Loyalty. For each reward, you can define how many times a single member can redeem it within a rolling eligibility window (e.g., “up to 3 times per 30 days”). Once a member hits their limit, the reward is unavailable to them until older redemptions fall out of the eligibility window.
(Enhancement / General availability (GA) / Loyalty - June 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Loyalty Floating Widget header now displays dynamic loyalty information
item.description:
The floating widget header now automatically shows the most relevant information for each customer, including Tier, Points, Store Credit, and Joined Date, based on their status and your loyalty program configuration.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - June 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Sync customer profile data to Shopify metafields
item.description:
Make Okendo survey, quiz, and loyalty profile data available in Shopify segmentation, Flow automations, and reporting, and pass it to connected platforms like Klaviyo. Put your data to work to build richer segments and trigger more targeted automations, all without leaving Shopify.
(Enhancement / Okendo Platform - June 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Collect reviews for bundles, individual items, or both
item.description:
Ask customers to review the bundle as a whole, the individual items inside it, or both. Ensure your review requests feel relevant and your product pages build the social proof that matters most.
(General availability (GA) / Reviews - May 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Transform customer engagement with auto review replies
item.description:
AI-generated replies to reviews can now be configured based on review sentiment. Configure per-sentiment toggles, word limits, reply delays and privacy settings from your Reviews settings.
(General availability (GA) / New feature / Reviews - May 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Subtotal Loyalty integration
item.description:
You can now issue loyalty points to members when they link their accounts and purchases from major retail partners including Amazon, Target and Walmart (via Subtotal). Extend your loyalty program beyond your online store.
(General availability (GA) / Integration / Loyalty - May 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Pre-fill details for logged-in shoppers
item.description:
When a shopper is logged into your store, Okendo now automatically pre-fills their email address and name across every Okendo surface they encounter. Shoppers spend less time entering details and more time completing the actions that matter; leaving reviews, joining loyalty programs, sharing referrals, and more.
(Enhancement / Okendo Platform - May 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Surfacing store credit balances in landing pages
item.description:
Members can now view their store credit balance on your program’s landing page, via the Profile module and Redeem Rewards module. Available to merchants with store credits enabled and a Loyalty Page Plus landing page.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - May 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Turn customer accounts into a review engine
item.description:
Drive review volume by activating Shopify’s customer account experience. Add review CTAs to order history, highlight unreviewed products, and make leaving feedback effortless.
(General availability (GA) / Reviews - April 2026)

item.title: [Quarterly Release] Q1 2026 Product Updates
item.description:
From updates to help you build stronger loyalty programs to improved reporting to better understand your reviews, unlock more ways power personalized customer experiences.
(Quarterly Release - April 2026)

item.title: [Referrals] Export referral request activity
item.description:
You can now export referral activity to CSV for further analysis. Fine tune your referral program by honing in on drop-off points in the referral journey or identify new opportunities among your current advocates.
(Enhancement / Referrals - April 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Video transcription & accessibility for reviews media
item.description:
AI-generated video transcriptions and image alt-tags are now automatically created for reviews with media attached, surfacing inline subtitles and full transcripts in the storefront media modal and admin moderation panel.
(Enhancement / Reviews - March 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Set style and title settings, per module
item.description:
You can now set style and module title settings for each individual module, in Loyalty Page Plus. These improvements enable you to change each module’s appearance separately from others, giving you even more flexibility and control over the look and feel of your landing page.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - March 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Track loyalty enrollment channels
item.description:
You can now identify exactly where members join your loyalty program. An enrollment channel property is now included in customer exports and syncs automatically to your marketing automation platforms, allowing you to build more targeted segments, lists and automations.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - March 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Use Okendo Loyalty events in Shopify Flow
item.description:
Use Okendo Loyalty events (as triggers) in Shopify Flows. Automate processes off the back of your member’s actions.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - February 2026)

item.title: [Quizzes] Quiz response created trigger for Shopify Flow
item.description:
A new Shopify Flow trigger is now available for quiz responses that include an email address.
(Enhancement / Quizzes - February 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] HTTP Block for Sequences
item.description:
You can now forward sequence data from Okendo to external tools using a configurable HTTP request.
(General availability (GA) / Reviews - February 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Configurable selection limits for multi-select questions
item.description:
You can now set minimum and maximum selection limits on multi-select questions across Product attributes, Profile questions, Surveys, and Quizzes. The maximum limit of options that are able to be selected has also been increased from 5 to 10.
(Enhancement / Okendo Platform - February 2026)

item.title: [Quizzes] Send coupons in product recommendation emails
item.description:
Email marketing platforms such as Klaviyo now receive quiz reward data, allowing for dynamic insertion of coupon codes into product recommendation emails.
(Enhancement / Quizzes - February 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] Custom perks captured as key-value pairs
item.description:
Custom perk are now captured as key-value pairs, streamlining VIP Tier tables and simplifying the member experience.
(Enhancement / General availability (GA) / Loyalty - February 2026)

item.title: [Reviews] Make data-driven decisions with Okendo’s updated performance reporting
item.description:
Access a rich set of review data to better understand product performance, customer sentiment, review capture, and more.
(General availability (GA) / Reporting / Reviews - February 2026)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] New Okendo Loyalty properties & events in Omnisend
item.description:
Okendo Loyalty now syncs custom contact properties and events to Omnisend, enabling segmentation and automation based on loyalty program data.
(General availability (GA) / Integration / Okendo Platform - February 2026)

item.title: [Surveys] Survey & Quiz responses now available via API
item.description:
New Merchant REST API endpoints let you fetch a list of responses for Surveys and Quizzes, making it easier to sync data with your systems and external reporting tools.
(Enhancement / Quizzes / Surveys - January 2026)

item.title: [Loyalty] More control over points expiry periods
item.description:
Points expiry periods can now be specified in days, providing greater control over your loyalty program liability, particularly for non-members.
(Enhancement / General availability (GA) / Loyalty - January 2026)

item.title: [Quarterly Release] Q4 2025 Product Updates
item.description:
From new AI features to stronger loyalty experiences, discover new features that help you connect more meaningfully with your customers.
(Quarterly Release - January 2026)

item.title: [Quizzes] Collect and activate profile data with Quizzes
item.description:
Turn quiz responses into reusable zero-party customer data you can use across Okendo touchpoints and marketing campaigns.
(General availability (GA) / Quizzes - December 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Help members redeem by showcasing free product rewards
item.description:
Display free product rewards in a separate module. Smart logic automatically hides out-of-stock rewards, keeping your program running smoothly.
(General availability (GA) / Loyalty - December 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Launch on-brand loyalty pages faster
item.description:
Design beautiful, high-performing loyalty pages that match your brand and drive engagement. The Loyalty Page Plus Builder gives you greater creative control with expanded styling options directly inside Okendo.
(General availability (GA) / Loyalty - October 2025)

item.title: [Quarterly Release] Q3 2025 Product Updates
item.description:
From powerful integrations to smarter automation, discover new features that help you connect more meaningfully with your customers.
(Quarterly Release - October 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Collect reviews directly from inboxes with In-Mail
item.description:
In-Mail makes it easy for shoppers to submit reviews straight from their email. Designed for a frictionless experience, it removes redirects for a faster, smoother path to sharing feedback.
(Reviews - September 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Launch app-first loyalty experiences with Tapcart
item.description:
Okendo Loyalty now integrates with Tapcart, making it easy for brands to bring rewards, tiers, and perks directly into their mobile app for a seamless on-the-go experience.
(Integration / Loyalty - September 2025)

item.title: [Quizzes] Automatically refresh cart values
item.description:
A new setting under Recommendations Page automatically refreshes cart values when products are added. Enabled by default, it can be turned off for custom cart setups.
(Enhancement / Quizzes - September 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Control the member login flow
item.description:
Redirect members after login to their account page, loyalty page, or back to where they left off for a seamless and personalized login experience.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - August 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Send real-time loyalty data with Webhooks
item.description:
Access and act on loyalty events instantly. Power custom workflows and integrations across your tools with real-time data.
(Loyalty - August 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Display points earning potential in the cart
item.description:
Let members see how many points they’ll earn in the cart, reinforcing program value and motivating them to complete their purchase.
(Enhancement / Loyalty - August 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Store credit now available in Shopify POS
item.description:
Extend store credit redemptions in-store with Shopify POS. Staff can convert points to credit and apply it at checkout for a seamless, consistent loyalty experience.
(Integration / Loyalty - August 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Increase accessibility on review images
item.description:
Boost accessibility and SEO with auto-generated alt text for customer photos, making your store more inclusive and easier to discover.
(New feature / Reviews - August 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Turn AI Summaries into global social proof
item.description:
Shoppers can translate AI Summaries into their preferred language for a localized experience that builds trust and boosts conversions.
(Enhancement / Reviews - July 2025)

item.title: [Surveys] Unlock deeper insights with survey data
item.description:
Push responses to the tools you use every day to automate alerts, create support tickets, and generate actionable insights with Surveys Webhooks
(Surveys - July 2025)

item.title: [Quizzes] Activate quiz insights across your tech stack
item.description:
Send quiz submission data to ESPs, CRMs, or analytics tools in real time to segment customers, trigger campaigns, and drive higher conversions with Webhooks for Quizzes.
(Quizzes - July 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Celebrate member anniversaries
item.description:
Boost retention by celebrating loyal members with anniversary rewards that show appreciation and spark re-engagement.
(New feature / Loyalty - July 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Pre-built Flows now available in Klaviyo
item.description:
Ready-to-use templates are now live in Klaviyo’s Flow Library for Reviews and Loyalty—so you can launch high-performing automations faster and with less effort.
(Integration / Loyalty / Reviews - July 2025)

item.title: [Quarterly Release] Q2 2025 Product Updates
item.description:
Uncover new loyalty capabilities like store credit, achievements, bonus points, and deeper integrations across your tech stack.
(Quarterly Release - July 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Make your data go further with Reviews Webhooks
item.description:
Send real-time review insights to any tool in your tech stack, fueling personalized experiences and advanced workflows.
(New feature / Reviews - June 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Integrate Okendo with Iterable
item.description:
Easily incorporate Okendo data into your Iterable journeys and templates, enabling personalized and timely communications that engage your customers. Enhance your messaging with rich customer data like reviews, loyalty status, and more.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - June 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Show points preview at checkout
item.description:
Boost engagement by showing your customers how many points they’ll earn on their order directly at checkout. This increased transparency encourages more spending while reminding customers of the value they’re getting through your loyalty program.
(New feature / Loyalty - June 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Set custom points expiry periods
item.description:
Take control of your loyalty strategy by customizing the points expiry period to fit your brand. Choose from 1 to 60 months (default is 12 months) to reduce points liabilities and create a more tailored experience for your customers.
(Loyalty - June 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Personalize every message with Braze
item.description:
Sync Okendo data to Braze to create more relevant, impactful customer journeys. Build stronger relationships and drive more conversions with messages that resonate.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - May 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Postscript integration now supports all Okendo products
item.description:
Okendo now sends profile and event data from all products to Postscript, making it easier to build personalized flows, and targeted campaigns.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - May 2025)

item.title: [Quizzes] Optional email collection in Quizzes
item.description:
You can now disable the email step in Quizzes to reduce drop-off and deliver frictionless product recommendations that keep shoppers engaged.
(Enhancement / Quizzes - May 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Points preview on product pages
item.description:
Let loyalty members see how many points they’ll earn while they shop, with the points preview displayed directly on the product page.
(New feature / Loyalty - May 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Connect to Klaviyo with OAuth authentication
item.description:
Connect Okendo to Klaviyo via secure OAuth authentication for faster setup, improved security, and easier account connection.
(Integration / Okendo Platform - April 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Simplify reward redemption with Store Credit
item.description:
Give members a cash-like way to redeem points at checkout. Store Credit makes rewards more flexible, motivating, and easy to use—driving higher spend and satisfaction.
(New feature / Loyalty - April 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Seamless member imports
item.description:
Easily migrate loyalty members with faster imports, built-in error previews, and the flexibility to import post-launch.
(Loyalty - April 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Gamify your loyalty program with Achievements
item.description:
Reward key member actions with animated badges to boost engagement and bring gamification to your loyalty program with Achievements.
(New feature / Loyalty - April 2025)

item.title: [Quarterly Release] Q1 2025 Product Updates
item.description:
Explore AI-powered summaries, syndication to TikTok Shop, and new ways to drive engagement across the platform.
(Quarterly Release - April 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Turn social proof into sales with TikTok Shop
item.description:
Expand your reach by syndicating reviews directly to TikTok Shop. Build trust, influence purchase decisions and convert more shoppers with social proof.
(Integration / New feature / Reviews - March 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Loyalty now supports Shopify Hydrogen
item.description:
Okendo Loyalty now supports Shopify Hydrogen v2 (Remix), giving brands the flexibility to build fully custom, on-brand loyalty experiences on headless storefronts.
(Integration / Loyalty - March 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Maximize engagement with Bonus Points
item.description:
Give loyalty members more reasons to shop with exclusive, time-based Bonus Points offers. Create urgency, drive engagement, and boost repeat purchases.
(New feature / Loyalty - March 2025)

item.title: [Quizzes] Turn shoppers into loyal subscribers
item.description:
Drive predictable revenue with Subscription Recommendations in quiz results. Convert high-intent shoppers effortlessly, increasing retention and long-term growth.
(Integration / New feature / Quizzes - March 2025)

item.title: [Reporting] Boost engagement with VIP Tier insights
item.description:
Gain deeper insights into your VIP tiers, helping you track performance, monitor member progression, and refine strategies to boost engagement and loyalty program success.
(New feature / Loyalty / Reporting - March 2025)

item.title: Highlight incentivized reviews
item.description: Automatically tag incentivized reviews so customers know when rewards were offered. Build trust through transparency, without any manual work for your team.

item.title: [Loyalty] Protect your loyalty program with member-only coupons
item.description:
Prevent coupon misuse by restricting loyalty rewards to the member who redeemed them, keeping your program fair and ensuring rewards stay exclusive to your loyal customers.
(Loyalty - February 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Enroll new loyalty members in store with Shopify POS
item.description:
Customers can join your loyalty program in-store at checkout with Shopify POS, helping you grow your program, increase engagement, and build stronger customer relationships.
(Integration / Loyalty - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Save time with auto-published AI Summaries
item.description:
AI-generated review summaries can now auto-publish once created, saving you time on manual approvals. This optional setting makes it easier to streamline review management.
(Enhancement / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Quizzes] Resize recommended product images
item.description:
Easily resize product images, adjust aspect ratios, and customize display settings to match your PDP styling for a more cohesive and on-brand shopping experience.
(Enhancement / Quizzes - February 2025)

item.title: [Okendo Platform] Drive sales with stackable discounts
item.description:
Okendo-generated discounts can now be combined with any Shopify discounts across Reviews, Loyalty, Quizzes, and Referrals and Surveys. Give customers more ways to save while driving engagement and sales.
(Okendo Platform - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Deeper insights with enhanced review data exports
item.description:
Review exports now include upvote and downvote counts, giving you greater visibility into customer sentiment and helping you make more informed, data-driven decisions.
(Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Highlight customer media with featured reviews tags
item.description:
Featured tags are now supported in the media grid and media carousel widgets, giving you more flexibility in how they display user generated content.
(Enhancement / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Collect more reviews with Customer Accounts
item.description:
Brands with a launched Loyalty program can now enable product reviews in Shopify Customer Accounts, making it easier to collect feedback from past purchases.
(Integration / Loyalty / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] AI Summaries for faster review insights
item.description:
Increase conversions with AI-generated review summaries. Turn high-volume social proof into clear insights, helping shoppers buy with confidence.
(New feature / Reviews - February 2025)

item.title: [Loyalty] Improved loyalty member imports
item.description:
Okendo Loyalty now lets you exclude members with a 0-point balance, 0 points spent, and no VIP tier from imports, helping you maintain clean data and focus on engaged customers.
(Loyalty - February 2025)

item.title: [Reviews] Expanded review request email eligibility
item.description:
Orders no longer need a first or last name to receive review request emails sent through Okendo, making it easier to collect more customer reviews.
(Enhancement / Reviews - February 2025)
